listings.name: Savannah Language & Culture Exchange — First Friday Mahjong
listings.description: Mahjong on the first Friday of the month at the Language & Culture Exchange in Savannah. Both Chinese and American styles are played, beginners are taught, and there is no charge — donations are welcome. Bring a set if you have one so several games can run at once.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Savannah, verified on the group's own events page: 4 upcoming "First Friday Mahjong" sessions, 19:30-21:30, with Meetup recording "Every 1st Friday of the month". BOTH STYLES ARE PLAYED — the description reads "Whether you prefer Chinese or American style, you're a beginner or experienced, join us". The schema takes one value, so this is recorded as american and the description says both; do not read the field as a claim that Chinese is not played here. Cost and the request to bring a set are quoted from the same description.

listings.name: American Mahjong Monday — Library 21c

listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Colorado Springs. The candidate came from ladies-of-the-front-range, which cross-posts these, but the sessions are run by american-mahjong-cos — its own description says it "has generously offered to teach us for free" — so the listing points at the organising group. That group's calendar shows four distinct weekly sessions: Monday 09:15 and Wednesday 13:00 and Saturday 13:00 at Library 21c, and Thursday 12:00 at Treehouse Cafe. Meetup's venue records write the library three ways — "21C Library", "Colorado Springs Library 21 C" and "Pikes Peak Library District - Library 21c" — all at 1175 Chapel Hills Dr; one name is used here.

listings.name: Mah Jongg Morning at the Encino Farmers Market
listings.cost: $75 for unlimited play for a year
listings.description: Open-play Mah Jongg on the ADC covered patio at OneGeneration, during the Encino Farmers Market, on Sunday mornings once a month from 9am to 1pm. Free parking and free filtered water — bring a reusable bottle. The patio is steps from the market. $75 buys unlimited play for a year.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Long Beach. Meetup records no venue for these events, but the event description publishes the address itself — "OneGeneration 17400 Victory Blvd Van Nuys, CA 91406" — so this is a venue listing rather than city-level. The market is in Encino and the address is in Van Nuys; the city field follows the published address and generalArea carries the market name. RSVP goes to luma.com/qmd5an0f, which the description asks for in capitals, not to Meetup. 4 upcoming dates, all Sunday 09:00-13:00: 13 Sep, 4 Oct, 1 Nov, 6 Dec — first Sunday of the month except September. Meetup records no series, so "monthly" comes from those dates. STYLE NOT STATED by the organiser — recorded as american on the base rate for US social play; confirm before relying on it.
